Indulge in our signature two-tier clear acrylic classic box, beautifully decorated with ribbons and festive tags. Reusable, elegant, and perfect for Diwali gifting.
Option 1 Includes:
Almond Rocks (150g)
Apple Walnut Cake 6 inch
Option 2 Includes:
Fresh Madeleines (4 pcs)
Assorted Cookies (16 pcs)
Box sizes Approx - 7x7 and 4x4 inch
Customisation is available to suit your preferences and gifting needs.

name: The Keepsake
description: A smaller, thoughtful gifting option combining two Ceremony favourites - crisp, indulgent cookies and rich chocolate Toffee Bark. Simple, elegant and easy to gift.

name: The Everyday
description: A comforting selection of freshly baked favourites - from soft cookies and rich brownies to delicate madeleines. Perfect for an afternoon of indulgence or festive sharing.

name: The Indulge
description: A chocolate-led collection for the true chocolate lover, pairing classic Toffee Bark with the fresh notes of Matcha and the richness of Coffee.

name: The Feast
description: A generous assortment of Ceremony favourites, bringing together rich toffee bark, buttery cookies and indulgent almond rocks. A well-rounded box for sharing and celebrating.

name: Flourless Chocolate Cloud Cake
description: Best selling fudgy and creamy not to mention gluten free chocolate cake. Topped with coffee flavoured Mascarpone.

name: Keto Chocolate Torte Gluten Free
description: Nut flour based Dark Chocolate Cake, with no gluten. Long lasting, the perfect travel companion. Keto Friendly.

name: Tomato Basil Sauce
description:
Ready-to-Use Gourmet Tomato Sauce.
A classic blend of sun ripened tomatoes and fragrant basil, and the goodness of extra virgin olive oil, this sauce is your perfect companion for any meal that requires a tomato base. Be it Shakshuka or pasta or pizza or even Moroccan stew or Rajma chawal.

name: Ultimate Pecan Granola
description: Fine pecans, slow-toasted oats, and brown rice puffs with honey and cinnamon. Oven-baked for a light, golden crunch with a hint of natural sweetness.

name: Carrot Cake
description:
Old Fashion Carrot Cake, with chopped walnuts and cozy spices. Topped with a delicious cream cheese frosting.
The perfect cake to go with your cuppa.

name: Seed Crackers
description: Seed Crackers ~ For Hormonal Balance, Good Skin & Hair. Packed with Protein, fiber and Omega 3's. Gluten Free and Vegan. Perfect for snacking, travel and cheeseboards.

name: Oatmeal Crackers
description: Oatmeal Crackers ~ Stone-ground oats baked into golden, toasted wafers. A wholesome, biscuity snack that feels light yet filling.

name: Sourdough Crackers
description: Sourdough Crackers ~ Thin and Crispy crackers made with sourdough discard seasoned with Sesame seeds and Maldon Sea Salt.

name: Dark Chocolate Almonds Rocks
description: A composition of roasted almonds and dark chocolate, lifted with notes of bitter orange and cacao.Structured, restrained, and quietly indulgent. Naturally rich in healthy fats, magnesium, and antioxidants — supporting steady energy and a more balanced way to indulge.

name: Signature Chocolate Cake
description: Our signature chocolate cake is rich, moist and velvety. The soft chocolate cake layers are packed with dark chocolate and a generous helping of chocolate custard. This is pastry decadence at its best.

name: Croquembouche
description: A spectacular masterpiece of caramel-covered cream puffs filled with an assortment of Vanilla, Coffee and Chocolate pastry cream, the croquembouche is the ultimate ceremonial cake.

name: Tiramisu
description: A classic transformed, this layered tiramisu cake pairs coffee and rum soaked home made lady finger biscuits with a mix of whipped mascarpone and zabaglione.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookie
description: Gooey Melty Chocolate chip cookies with flaky sea salt topping

name: Grain Free Buckwheat Granola
description: Naturally grain-free and crafted for those who love a wholesome, earthy crunch. This mix of nutrient-dense buckwheat and slow-toasted seeds is glazed in honey for a light finish.

name: Honey Comb Chocolate
description: Crunchy chunks of honeycomb covered in smooth and creamy chocolate. This sweet treat will take you right back to your childhood.

name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
description: British dessert consisting of a moist sponge cake, made with finely chopped dates, with toffee sauce on the side and served with vanilla ice-cream for some extra oomph.

name: Oatmeal and Raisin Cookies
description: Soft and chewy with burnt butter caramel flavour, for when you have a serious craving for something wholesome. Made with brown sugar, vanilla, burnt butter, chewy oats, black currants, and a secret ingredient, you will keep coming back for more.

name: Walnut Brownies
description:
Perfected over time.
Dense, chocolate-rich with a thin crust and slow roasted walnuts

name: Biscoff Brownie
description:
Perfected over time.
Dense, chocolate-rich with a thin crust and dark, speckled with crispy biscoff biscuits

name: Jaggery Millet Brownie
description: Made with Sorghum Flour, jaggery, these brownies are gluten free and refined sugar free. Dense, chocolate-rich with a thin crust, speckled with nuts.

name: Matcha Cloud Cake
description:
What is Ceremony without Ceremonial Grade Matcha? Our Matcha Gâteau au Chocolat - a cake that's light, delicately fudgy, and melts effortlessly on the palate.
A little Japanese restraint. A little French indulgence.

name: Toffee Barks
description: The Toffee Bark is rich, buttery, sweet, and salty with a layer of toffee, dark chocolate, roasted almonds and a sprinkle of sea salt. Our Bark is crafted for a clean snap and addictive like adult nutty's. These make for a wonderful gift that will put you in the category of best gift giver.

name: Assorted Brownies
description:
Assorted Brownies
A refined Indulgence. Experience the art of fine chocolate with our elegantly curated selection of assorted brownies. Each piece is handcrafted to perfection, featuring rich, fudgy textures layered with premium ingredients—from crunchy nuts to delicate biscuit accents and smooth chocolate drizzles.
Thoughtfully crafted for moments of indulgence, every bite is a celebration of depth, flavor, and timeless sophistication.

name: Keto Coffee Cloud Cake
description: Naturally gluten free since it has zero flour, the keto cloud cake yields an ultra-moist, and melt-in-your-mouth interior. Topped with coffee flavoured mascarpone and dusted with pure dutch processed cocoa powder. No sugar in raw ingredients and no added sugar.

name: Chocolate Walnut Tea Cake
description: The Perfect Tea Cake, crafted with Intention and Nourishment

name: Chocolate Walnut Tea Cake Gluten Free
description: The Perfect Gluten Free Tea Cake, crafted with intention and nourishment

name: Tiramisu Gluten Free
description: What can we say, other than the best Tiramisu in town, that too Gluten Free!

name: Bon Bons
description: A curated collection of our finest bon bons — the Assorted Box is perfect for tasting, gifting, and celebrating every mood and moment. Flavours: Orange, Sea Salt, Caramel, Strawberry, Hazelnut, Chocolate

name: Biscoff Cheesecake
description: A baked Lotus Biscoff cheesecake that’s creamy and rich with a biscuity crumb base.

name: Peanut Butter
description: Made using traditional methods with only premium roasted peanuts and sweetened using honey. An irresistibly original taste with crispy peanuts and flaky sea salt.

name: Hazelnut Spread
description: Made using 70% Real hazelnuts and single origin chocolate, carefully handcrafted using all-natural ingredients, balanced to a precise, refined sweetness.

name: Pecan Brownies
description:
Perfected over time.
Dense, chocolate-rich with a thin crust and slow roasted pecans.

name: Onion Chilli Jam
description: The onion chili jam has a sweet and spicy flavor that has a myriad of uses. Think cheese platters, sandwiches, hot dogs, matthi.

name: Sugar Free Chocolate Bars
description: Available in sugarfree milk with roasted hazelnut, roasted almond and sea salt. Also available in a proprietary blend of dark and sugar free chocolate. The sugar free chocolate is sweetened with maltitol.

name: Keto Truffles
description: Made entirely with a masterful blend of dark chocolate and sugar free chocolate, at 70 calories a pop, 4 gms of carbs, 2 gms of protein and 6 gms of fat per truffle

name: Assorted Truffles: Chef Curation
description: A French chocolate confectionery traditionally made with a chocolate ganache centre, handrolled and coated with different flavours like Sea Salt, Roasted Almond, Coffee, Hazelnut. We are always trying new flavours - life's like a box of chocolate - you never know what you are gonna get!

name: Orange Cake with Orange Curd Gluten Free
description: Made with whole oranges, soft, rich, and flavorful, Italian almond and orange cake. It’s topped with a fresh orange curd and drenched in home made Cointreau.

name: Coffee Cloud Cake
description: Completely Gluten free and tastes like a cross between a truffle and a brownie! Topped with coffee flavoured Mascarpone.

name: Madeleines
description: This mini cake was made by a local woman named Madeline for the King of France and where ever he went, Madelines followed. Flavour options include - Vanilla, Chocolate Chip, Lemon. Best Served with Tea and Coffee.

name: Marble Cake with Rocher Glaze
description: With swirls of tender vanilla and fudgy chocolate cake, marble cake is pure old-fashioned goodness covered with a signature Ferrero Rocher glaze.

name: Apple Walnut Cake
description: Childhood masterpiece - have been making it since I was 12 - and even after Cordon Bleu - The recipe is pure gold.

name: Concerto Chocolate Cake
description: Decadent chocolate mousse cake, with layers of hazelnut & almond praline & feuilletine crunch.

name: Dark Chocolate Mix
description: A deep, high-cocoa blend crafted for the purist. Whether you whisk it into hot milk, cold water or stir it into cold cream, it feels like drinking a bar of perfectly balanced, bittersweet chocolate.

name: Milk Chocolate Mix
description: The ultimate comfort in a cup, offering a smooth, creamy profile with a toasted honey-like sweetness. It transforms into a rich, fluid version of a classic chocolate bar—uncompromisingly smooth and indulgent. Perfect as a velvety hot cocoa or a refreshing chilled treat, mixed exactly how you prefer.

name: Pecan Granola with Chocolate
description: Fine pecans and dark chocolate chunks tossed with slow-toasted oats, pumpkin seeds, and brown rice puffs. Glazed in honey and cinnamon for a light, golden crunch.

name: Apple Walnut Cake Gluten Free
description: Apple Walnut Cake with Gluten Free Sorghum Flour. Childhood masterpiece - have been making it since I was 12 - and even after Cordon Bleu - The recipe is pure gold.

name: Chocolate Torte Gluten Free
description: Nut flour based Dark Chocolate Cake, with no gluten. Long lasting, the perfect travel companion.

name: Vegan Signature Chocolate Cake
description: As any good chocolate cake fanatic, I have a strong idea of how a chocolate cake should taste: rich, dark, moist, decadent....this one does all of the above and more.

name: Signature Chocolate Cake Gluten Free
description: As any good chocolate cake fanatic, I have a strong idea of how a chocolate cake should taste: rich, dark, moist, decadent....this one does all of the above and more.

name: Sugar Free Nut & Seed Bark
description: This treat is gluten-free, dairy-free, vegan and sugar free. Making it a versatile option for various dietary needs. Designed for everyday hormonal balance + blood sugar stability. Also for Cortisol regulation and nervous system support. Better omega balance, Lower inflammatory load and improved hormone + gut support.

name: Chocolate Crinkle Cookie
description: These fudgy chocolate Crinkle Cookies contain all the best parts of a brownie: crackly top crust, fudgy middles, chewy edges, & intense chocolate flavor dusted with pista flakes.
